about.title: About
about.subtitle: Backend and platform engineer with 12+ years in software. Today I split my time between an applied-AI platform and the service platform other teams build on — and I run the whole stack at home to keep the platform skills honest.

cv.description: Senior backend and platform engineer with 12+ years in software — Go, Kotlin, Kubernetes, GitOps and observability. Full CV with experience, skills and education.
cv.summaryText: Senior software engineer with 12+ years in software, focused on backend and platform engineering. Go, Kotlin and Java for services; Kubernetes, ArgoCD, Terraform and CI/CD for delivery; OpenTelemetry, Prometheus and Grafana for observability. Currently leading the technical side of an applied-AI platform that turns 300k+ support tickets per month into executive insight, with LLM pipelines designed so personally identifiable information never reaches the models.
